note: 0.1.2 AC-2 class-A review round 2 (findings 1-7): the denied-call matcher, one path at a time. A plain word holding letters of HASH(0x...) is no distinctive token (finding 1: an unescaped @_), so a refused `git push origin HEAD` covers every push approval by class; a refused Write covers the approval naming its file name only (finding 2); a rule refusal quoting a multi-line command is read (finding 3); `plugin` of a plugin MCP server name is a stop word (finding 4); the user's rejection at the prompt covers by a service word alone; a token stands whole (hotfix/7 is not hotfix/77, xhotfix/7 or a.hotfix/7) and so does a service word (jiraboard is not jira); a refusal on a sidechain row counts (round 3: agent calls are this session's); a Write or Edit is read by its path only; a usable line with a denial note in its action or after given is approval-denied (finding 6); a malformed tagged line in a plugin handoff turn is approval-plugin-turn (finding 7)
